title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
March 21, 2025
Scott S. Harris
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, N.E.
Washington, D.C. 20543

Re: Dwayne Barrett v. United States
No. 24-5774

Dear Mr. Harris:

I am counsel of record for Petitioner Dwayne Barrett in the abovecaptioned case, in which the Court granted certiorari on March 3, 2025.

After conferring with counsel for Respondent and Court-appointed
amicus curiae, we jointly propose the following briefing schedule:

• Briefs for Petitioner and Respondent (and Joint Appendix) will be
due on May 23, 2025;

• Brief for appointed amicus curiae will be due on July 28, 2025.

This proposed schedule reflects mutually agreed-upon extensions
for the parties, which are necessary due to the heavy press of business
for all counsel.
Thank you very much for your consideration.
       Respectfully,
       s/ Matthew B. Larsen
       Assistant Federal Defender

cc: Aimee W. Brown, Esq.
 Charles L. McCloud, Esq.
